# Home of Creativity (HOC / بيت الإبداع)

> Home of Creativity (HOC) — بيت الإبداع — is a creative and branding agency. Published offices: Damascus (Al Hamra), Riyadh (Al Murabaa), and the United Arab Emirates (city and street not published). Official site: https://hoc.agency/

Also known as: HOC, بيت الإبداع, بيت الابداع, Creativation Source.

Home of Creativity does not claim star ratings, review counts, or "#1 agency" rankings.

## Facts

- Legal / brand name: Home of Creativity (HOC)
- Arabic name: بيت الإبداع
- Website: https://hoc.agency/
- Offices: Damascus (Al Hamra), Syria — https://hoc.agency/locations/damascus/ ; Riyadh (Al Murabaa), Saudi Arabia — https://hoc.agency/locations/riyadh/ ; United Arab Emirates — named, city and street not published, no location page yet
- Markets: Syria, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates
- Contact: Telegram and WhatsApp from https://hoc.agency/ (Syria WhatsApp https://wa.me/963954187154 ; Saudi WhatsApp https://wa.me/966550350295)
- Languages: Arabic and English on the same URLs
- How work starts: quotation from Home of Creativity; payment confirmed on WhatsApp; no self-serve web checkout
- Not published: founding year, team roster, awards, client counts, industry list, ratings, LinkedIn company URL, Google Business Profile URLs

## Services

Visual identities; social media; account management; marketing; paid ads; exhibitions and conferences; event management; booth design; filming and editing; promo gifts; roadside ads; websites and ecommerce; app design; financial analysis.

Monthly flexible production: Premium Pack $399, Growth Pack $599, Infinity Pack $899, Reels Premium $399, Reels Pro $699. One-time reach: Reach Package $50, Gold Package $100, Diamond Package $200. Billing for 3 months is 5% off, 6 months 10% off, and yearly 20% off the monthly total. Payment is confirmed on WhatsApp.
